# Saadiq Rodgers-King — AI Transformation Consulting

> Embedded AI consulting for tech companies. I get product and engineering teams unstuck.

Saadiq Rodgers-King is an AI transformation consultant based in Brooklyn, NY.
Princeton CS, MIT Sloan MBA. 20+ years across product, engineering, and strategy.
He embeds with teams at tech companies to move AI initiatives from pilot to production.

## What I Do

I work with CEOs and CPOs at tech companies where the team has AI tools but nothing has changed. I embed with product and engineering teams, work on their actual processes, and transfer the capability so it stays when I leave.

Product teams get live intelligence — customer support signals, sales conversations, competitive moves, and usage analytics synthesized in real time instead of waiting for quarterly research cycles.

Engineering teams shift from grinding through tickets to building systems. Routine work gets executed by agents. Engineers focus on architecture, strategy, and the decisions that require judgment.
